latestDeviceChange.description: Timestamp of latest device swap performed. It must follow [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339#section-5.6) and must have time zone.

monitoredPeriod.description: Timeframe in days for device change supervision for the phone number. It could be valued in the response if the latest Device swap occurred before this monitored period.
